format: Rulebook edition admission, selection and no automatic upgrade (all bodies)
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): the platform owner admits an edition to the verified registry only after source validation, independent review, difference analysis and compatibility assessment; an authorized organizer selects an admitted edition for an event within verified applicability; no edition change is ever applied automatically to an existing event; organizer choice cannot disable a mandatory body rule.
interpretation_notes: Owner decision OD-30 items 1-3. Role mapping for 'platform owner' is open (design Q1). Design only: nothing implemented.
